definitions.explanation: The quality of being uniform throughout, with no variation in composition or properties. Used in materials science, sociology (cultural homogeneity), and statistics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{均質性|きんしつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: To maintain the homogeneity of the product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{均質性|きんしつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}れ→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The homogeneity of Japanese society is gradually weakening.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{均質性|きんしつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: We confirm the homogeneity of the data before moving on to analysis.

notes:
Compound of {均質|きんしつ} (uniform, homogeneous) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, property). Formal, technical register — found in scientific writing and social commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {均質性|きんしつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain homogeneity
- {均質性|きんしつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly homogeneous
- {均質性|きんしつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧: to verify homogeneity
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}{的|てき}→文化的：05688_bunkateki⟧{均質性|きんしつせい}: cultural homogeneity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {均一性|きんいつせい}: uniformity — emphasizes equal distribution rather than identical composition
- {一様性|いちようせい}: evenness — emphasizes lack of variation; more common in physics
- {同質性|どうしつせい}: same-nature quality — emphasizes shared identity, often in social contexts
